thread:
Maya: dropping a small design QA thread for the Autoscale compact row mock. goal = clarify labels, reduce burst prominence, and ensure inline validation is accessible. mock: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/autoscale-compact-row.png

Maya: quick asks: use short labels (Min GPUs / Max GPUs), move pool picker inline, put burst on a secondary row, and tighten SLO copy.

Sam: short labels 👍. can we keep helper under each input that says 'per-pool GPU instances'? helps newbies.

Jorge: on infra side, we need integer-only enforcement. show units next to values (e.g., "4 GPUs"). also validate pool limits when picker changes.

Leah: accessibility: the stepper needs a visible focus ring and proper ARIA. ensure we map to a hidden input[type=number] so screen readers get native semantics.

Leah: suggested aria snippet: <input id="min-gpus" type="number" aria-label="Min GPUs" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="2" />

Aria: microcopy for SLO label: 'SLO (p95 ms)' and muted helper 'Lower = stricter. Recommend quantization or smaller models if breached.'

Sam: about burst, move it below as 'Allow burst capacity' with helper 'Temporarily exceeds Max; billed only for extra GPUs used.' that reduces the visual weight.

Leah: tooltip-only billing copy is bad for keyboard users. place the full sentence inline and keep tooltip as extra. ensure the billing link has rel=noopener.

Jorge: pool-change validation: show inline callout 'Selected pool max: 6 GPUs — your Min: 8.' actions: 'Adjust to 6' / 'Keep 8'. emit telemetry ui.autoscale.poolValidation when shown.

Maya: inline callout must use role=alert and not rely on color. include an icon and readable text. animate only if prefers-reduced-motion is not set.

Sam: UX nit: when picker truncates, allow expand to modal with aria-expanded and aria-haspopup. selecting should persist by pool id, not index.

Leah: also ensure contrast for the burst label and helper meets WCAG. add focus-visible styles for the picker and links.

Aria: tweak SLO guardrail banner: 'Warning: raising Max GPUs may increase tail latency. We'll fall back to a smaller model if SLOs are breached.' short and explicit.

Maya: agree. make 'Warning' visually distinct but include full text in a visually-hidden span for screen readers when using color-only emphasis.

Jorge: implementation note: debounce pool constraint fetch on mobile (suggest 250ms) and cache last 5 responses to avoid cold RPCs. show spinner in picker during fetch.

Sam: final copy tweak for inputs helper: 'Minimum/Maximum number of GPU instances reserved for this pool.' short and consistent.

Maya: next steps: Sam update mock with inline picker + secondary burst row and billing helper; Jorge prototype hidden native input mapping and the debounce; Leah to run VoiceOver + contrast pass tomorrow AM; Aria finalize guardrail copy. will post updated mock.

design-bot: uploaded new image: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/autoscale-compact-row-v2.png

Maya: thanks everyone, will follow up with screenshots and a brief design doc link.
